programs: To extend and improve mobile phone coverage and competition across Australia, by co-funding new or upgraded telecommunications infrastructure.

The Grantee will provide new and upgraded mobile voice and data services in specified regional, rural and remote locations, using a combination of brownfield and greenfield sites and upgrades to existing fibre networks and backhaul.
The Commonwealth has made Funding available through Round 7 of the Mobile Black Spot Program (the Program) with the aim of extending mobile coverage in identified underserved areas of Australia.
The Mobile Network Hardening Program (MNHP) is a competitive grant opportunity to upgrade and improve the resilience of mobile telecommunications infrastructure in regional and peri-urban Australia.
To fund deployment of new mobile phone infrastructure that will provide improved quality of service to mobile telecommunications users in peri-urban fringe areas.

The Mobile Network Hardening Program (MNHP) is a competitive grant opportunity to upgrade and improve the resilience of mobile telecommunications infrastructure in regional, remote and peri-urban Australia impacted by, or at risk of, Natural Disasters.
